blurb: Rooted in the shifting atmosphere of the Oregon Coast, Nico Stiver's work reflects on change as one of life’s few constants-expressed through ever-changing light, weather, color, and the expansive relationship between land, water, and sky. Painterly and expressive, Stiver’s work moves between observation and abstraction.
